justification: Total des actifs comptabilisés à la date du bilan. Définition de la taxonomie recopiée depuis companyfacts (champ description). Définition (us-gaap) : « Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Assets are probable future economic benefits obtained or controlled by an entity as a result of past transactions or events. »

Revenus tirés des contrats avec les clients (ASC 606), hors taxes collectées : un COMPOSANT du revenu total, pas le total en général. Définition (us-gaap) : « Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise. »

Agrégat des revenus de l'entité (biens, services et autres activités, y compris les revenus hors contrats clients). Prioritaire pour total_revenue (revue n° 14). Définition (us-gaap) : « Amount of revenue recognized from goods sold, services rendered, insurance premiums, or other activities that constitute an earning process. Includes, but is not limited to, investment and interest income before deduction of interest expense when recognized as a component of revenue, and sales and trading gain (loss). »
